evals.prompt: Where do I put the k-ID API key, and how do I call k-ID from our Next.js app?
evals.expected_output: Server-only env var (no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix), a single proxy route that forwards allowlisted paths to k-ID with the bearer auth header; clients never call game-api.k-id.com directly.
assertions: API key is placed in a server-only env var (e.g. KID_API_KEY) with no client-exposed prefix like NEXT_PUBLIC_
Response describes a server proxy route (or API route) that forwards requests to k-ID
Bearer auth header is set server-side
Response recommends an allowlist of proxied paths for production
Response notes clients never call game-api.k-id.com directly

evals.prompt: Every request to /age-gate/check returns 401 with no body. We've quadruple-checked the key. What else?
evals.expected_output: Almost certainly a test-vs-prod key/URL mismatch; run the curl smoke test directly against KID_API_BASE_URL to confirm.
assertions: Response says to suspect test-vs-prod key/URL mismatch first
Response provides a curl command against KID_API_BASE_URL to isolate the issue
Response advises against retrying on 401 because it's usually config

evals.prompt: How do I enforce k-ID permissions on a privileged API route?
evals.expected_output: Fetch the session via the proxy, check session.permissions.find(p => p.name === required)?.enabled === true, return 403 on missing.
assertions: Response explicitly checks enabled === true (not truthy or just presence)
Response treats missing permission as false (not true)
Response returns 403 for unauthorized, 401 only for unauthenticated
Response does NOT suggest client-side-only enforcement as sufficient
